name: Dolmen gate
description: A free-standing gateway of three spiral-patterned, moss-covered stones that divides the bright meadow from a dark cave.

timeline.summary: The students discover a free-standing dolmen gate dividing the sunlit meadow from darkness and decide to go through to find help.
timeline.quote: They stepped through the dolmen gate, and the darkness swallowed them all.

timeline.summary: The darkness pours out of the dolmen gate, followed by distant screams.
timeline.quote: All that remained was the dark flowing out of the dolmen gate, and the distant sound of screams.

relations.note: The gate stands in the meadow where the students land.
relations.quote: There, behind where they had landed, was a massive gateway, formed of two tall stones with a third laid across them.

pages_say.description: A free-standing gateway of three spiral-patterned, moss-covered stones that divides the bright meadow from a dark cave.
